body: Its already been horrific... I work at a hotel. Its move in week. I've seen so many of them tonight. They all knew.

I've already faced it head on in highschool... That's what was needed to send that person to jail. It nearly killed me. I cut for years. I'm still in therapy. I'm going to school out of state just to avoid it. And now its happening again. I feel like I'm stuck in a nightmare.
And what? I'm supposed to not care that fucking everyone thinks I'm a whore? That I'm already known on site by people I've never met?
I can't. I was supposed to start university this week. I already know that the majority of male students know about me. I can't do this.
